meta.name: linkedin-repurposing
meta.description: Repurpose LinkedIn content across formats and leverage creator tools. Use when the user asks about repurposing content, turning posts into carousels, LinkedIn newsletters, LinkedIn Live, audio events, collaborative articles, content recycling, or getting more mileage from existing content. Do NOT use for writing new original content (use storytelling) or format specs (use formats).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将LinkedIn帖子一键变身为轮播、简报等多种格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常在LinkedIn创作内容,希望每条能发挥更大价值
copy.tagline_en: Turn your LinkedIn posts into carousels, newsletters, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create LinkedIn content and want to maximize each post's reach

howto.what: 当你要将LinkedIn内容二次利用到不同格式（如帖子转轮播、视频转帖子等），或使用LinkedIn的创作者工具（新闻稿、直播、音频活动等）时，Claude会提供转换方法和策略。它还会建议先通过ColdIQ分析最值得复用的内容。
howto.when: 当你询问如何将LinkedIn内容重新利用、转换格式（如帖子转轮播、视频转帖子等），或想使用LinkedIn新闻稿、直播、音频活动、协作文章等创作者工具时触发。

say.text: 帮我将这篇高互动的帖子转成8页的轮播图。
say.note: Claude会根据帖子内容提取关键点并设计轮播结构。

say.text: 上一个LinkedIn直播怎么做成3个短视频持续发布？
say.note: Claude会指导你剪辑亮点并安排发布时间。

say.text: 从这期新闻稿中提取3个独立帖子的素材。
say.note: Claude会抽出每条核心观点并配上独立钩子。

howto.what_en: Repurpose LinkedIn content across formats (e.g., text post to carousel, video to text post) and leverage LinkedIn creator tools (newsletters, Live, audio events) to maximize content ROI. Also suggests analyzing top posts via ColdIQ first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about repurposing LinkedIn content, converting formats, or using LinkedIn creator tools like newsletters, Live, audio events, or collaborative articles.

say_en.text: Turn this high-engagement post into an 8-slide carousel.
say_en.note: Claude extracts key points and suggests slide structure.

say_en.text: How to repurpose my last LinkedIn Live into 3 short clips?
say_en.note: Claude recommends cutting highlights and scheduling over days.

say_en.text: Extract 3 standalone posts from this newsletter edition.
say_en.note: Claude pulls each core insight with a new hook.
